_exemptionNotes.deployment-impact/card-text-budget: DeploymentComparisonSelector uses full-sentence comparison titles by design — these are the primary navigational labels, not secondary description text.
_exemptionNotes.decisions/unit-box-width: Decision guide option buttons span the grid width in 2-3 column layouts at 1440px. The 360px max is appropriate for the capability unit boxes; decision guide option buttons are wider by design (they contain a question text, not just a product name).
_exemptionNotes.decisions/card-text-budget: Decision guide question cards accumulate the full question text, option labels, and path hints in their visible text; this is the disclosure level for the guide. Exempts the card-text-budget check for all decision-guide states.
_exemptionNotes.products/row-fill: Search-filtered catalog results may produce a single orphan card when the query returns one match. This is correct filtered-state behavior; enforcing balance on dynamic search results would require artificial padding.
_exemptionNotes.products/no-ghost-cells: Search-filtered results may produce a single item in a 3-col grid. Correct filtered-state behavior; resting state has full rows.
_exemptionNotes.architecture/card-text-budget: Generate-from-Environment mode renders multi-field form sections whose aggregate text exceeds 140 chars by design. Blueprints mode shows comparison descriptions that are inherently verbose. Both are deliberate disclosure levels for their interaction mode. Does NOT cover FlowVisualization modal (architecture/flow-viz-modal state) — FlowViz cards comply directly at <= 140 chars.
_exemptionNotes.products/unit-box-width: ProductExplorer catalog cards are intentionally wider than the 360px max (they render in a 2-3 column grid at 1440px, producing ~400px cards). The wider width gives room for product name, status badge, and description. The 360px bound targets capability unit boxes, not product catalog cards.
